items.title: George Russell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...I believe Othello Ballet was Flying Dutchman. [INTERVIEWEE] It was, yeah.

ctx.x: I do believe – I hope I’m still right – I do believe I’m still right about Othello. It’s not about being right, but just accurate for posterity. I believe Othello Ballet was Flying Dutchman.
